description: A deployment's required-pack roster names waiveo/system with floor_version 1.0.0. The pack has since been updated to 3.0.0, so its resolved-version high-water mark for (waiveo/system, first-party) is 3.0.0 and its newest install record pins 3.0.0. The floor is nonetheless still 1.0.0: it is deployment-declared and never derived from what is installed, from the high-water mark, or from the install-record history. A second pack, acme/menu-board, is absent from the roster and is therefore not required at all, whatever its own index entry or manifest claims -- required status is resolved only through the host-provisioned roster, exactly as MKT-009b resolves a signing key only through the host's trust-anchor set. Deriving the floor from the highest version ever applied would put 3.0.0 under the floor's own protection and so would forbid MKT-093's revert to the earlier successfully-applied 2.0.0, which is by construction below it.
